summary: fractal-web supports an injectable session trace provider and reports unavailable or unattributed usage as Unknown instead of zero.

compatibility.detail: No server protocol change. The default provider reads native usage and leaves time buckets and subagents Unknown. Self-only token and cost meters require attribution evidence.

manual.detail: No installation action required. A deployment can inject a provider for additional trace facts. Provider results remain in memory.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
